subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this native folder-backed encrypted snapshot and backup config surface once blockers are fixed, or keep off-machine encrypted backup workflows in ClawHub/plugins?
rationale: The PR creates persistent config, destructive restore semantics, and credential/session-state handling that affect core product scope, upgrade behavior, and security policy.

options.title: Accept Scoped Native Snapshot Flow
options.body: Keep setup/run/list/restore in core only after the security, restore-layout, conflict, docs, and real-proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Keep Core To Export And Verify
options.body: Narrow or close this branch and route encrypted or cloud-like backup workflows to ClawHub/plugins while documenting the existing local archive flow.

options.title: Defer Behind Backup Umbrella Design
options.body: Pause this PR behind issue #13616 until maintainers settle archive format, config shape, restore overwrite policy, and secret/session handling.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Native Snapshot Flow
recommendation.body: Keep setup/run/list/restore in core only after the security, restore-layout, conflict, docs, and real-proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue #13616 review and recent backup docs/config history make this the best observed owner for the product-scope choice.
